observed_frontier.existing_request_receipt_identity: argv path string plus process outcome; no bound executable object identity

hypothesis.claim: A requested absolute executable path is insufficient provenance when the path can resolve to a different object between admission and process spawn.
hypothesis.mechanism: subprocess.Popen resolves the pathname at spawn time; a mutable symlink/path can therefore select a different executable while the request argv string remains unchanged.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: shell=false plus an absolute argv[0] is sufficient to bind executable identity.
hypothesis.falsifier: Hold the requested path string constant while changing the symlink target and observe whether different harmless executables run.

bounded_unusual_experiment.name: SYMLINK_SWAP_PROCESS_TARGET_IDENTITY

artifact_under_test.source: downloaded historical canonical one-file EntityOS workflow artifact
artifact_under_test.qualification: test object only; historical self-hosted build is not promoted as current release evidence under sandbox-only policy

bounded_unusual_experiment.rollback: symlink reset to /usr/bin/printf; no persistent host effect

candidate_repair.mechanism: Open argv[0] with Linux O_PATH|O_CLOEXEC, execute the opened object through /proc/self/fd/<fd> with pass_fds, and receipt-bind st_dev/st_ino/st_mode/st_size/st_mtime_ns.
candidate_repair.clayos_reentry: Executable object identity is copied into ClayOS process state.
candidate_repair.deterministic_regression: Retarget the symlink after executable open but before real Popen; execution must remain on the originally opened object.
